search_space_construction.two_distinct_objects: ClusteringSearchSpace instantiates estimators; the raw phaseE2 dict constrains the SAMPLER. They are not interchangeable.

historical_seed_caveat.finding: the Stage-3A AutoClust runner calls run_view with seed = seed + (hash(view_type) % 1000)
historical_seed_caveat.why_it_matters: Python str hashing is salted per process unless PYTHONHASHSEED is fixed, so the historical AutoClust candidate seed is not reproducible across processes
historical_seed_caveat.scope: affects Stage-4B-3A2 historical candidate-trace replay, NOT the Stage-4 external path
historical_seed_caveat.stage4_path: the external adapter uses the IDB derive_seed(dataset_id, view_id, method_id), which already varies by view and is fully deterministic; it must NOT replicate the hash(view_type) term
historical_seed_caveat.action: flagged for Stage 4B-3A2; historical CVI/predictor regression should replay PERSISTED traces rather than regenerate them from a seed

canonical_hash_convention.rule: UTF-8 bytes with CRLF normalised to LF, otherwise byte-preserving
